io :: import "std/io"

main :: fn() {
    numbers: [4]i32 = [10, 20, 30, 40]
    middle := numbers[1..3]
    index: usize = 0
    io.println("{} {}", middle[index], middle.len)

    left: [2]f64 = [1.0, 2.0]
    right: [2]f64 = [3.0, 4.0]
    sum: [2]f64 = left + right
    io.println("{} {}", sum[0], sum[1])

    text: string = "A7"
    prefix := text[0..1]
    for ch in prefix {
        io.print("{}", ch)
    }
    io.println(" {}", prefix.len)
}
